Application Data.NAME: Elegant Memories Bridal Boutique
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Elegant Memories Bridal Boutique specializes in providing a curated selection of high-quality bridal gowns, accessories, and personalized fittings to brides-to-be. Our operations include in-store consultations, custom alterations performed by licensed professionals, and an expanding online presence for e-commerce sales. We prioritize exceptional customer service and maintain a secure online shopping experience with robust cybersecurity measures. Our inventory management practices are designed to align with seasonal demand fluctuations, ensuring we meet our clients' needs while minimizing excess stock. We also conduct thorough employee screening to mitigate risks associated with employee dishonesty.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On June 15, 2023, a customer reported damage to a bridal gown due to a mix-up during fitting appointments, resulting in repair costs of $1,500. The repair has been completed, and the customer was satisfied with the outcome. As of today, the claim is closed. Additionally, on December 2, 2022, a minor incident involving a slip and fall in the store caused temporary business interruption, leading to a loss of $1,000 in revenue. This incident was resolved, and no claims were filed. Total losses reported: $2,500.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras and alarm system in place; regular inventory checks conducted by authorized personnel; employee training on theft prevention and loss control measures.
